summary: The inspected D17 bridges retain the actual-member, complete-link and exterior-support guards needed for their necessary-condition direction. The v9 copied-tail strengthening uses two separate HP15 applications and full four-trace columns; bounded tests of the actual validator reject the targeted incorrect alternatives. The H27 refinement correctly aggregates both marker-containing and marker-avoiding fine traces. No counterexample or necessary revision was found in this scoped adversarial review; it is not a full model rebuild or receipt replay.

findings.statement: Shared-builder verification does not independently establish every mathematical model row.
findings.disposition: This round directly inspected the marked-member, copied-tail, complement-profile and H27-transfer implications and exercised two isolated validators. Other row families and all combined exact arithmetic remain outside these bounded tests; the manuscript correctly retains the shared-builder limitation.

findings.statement: Arbitrary-support completeness requires preservation of all exterior completions when a marked point is represented.
findings.disposition: The inspected producer constructs every trace of size at most four, makes only full four-traces binary, and introduces the sole additional represented point through an actual selected member. The H27 refinement aggregates fine traces by restriction. No hidden ambient-support cutoff was identified in these mechanisms.
